message.content: {"action":"increase_precision","reason":"The current LUT design has SQNR of about 61.0 dB with area 1185.8 um^2. Increasing precision by one legal level is the only available action with a legal unvisited neighbor that can improve numerical quality, while the area cost should be modest relative to switching architecture or table capacity changes (which have no legal neighbors)."}
